text.text_excerpt: I feel like I'm a harsh critic when it comes to Vietnamese food since I am Vietnamese, but I LOVE Namese! You'll be paying a bit more for food compared to a typical Vietnamese restaurant but that's probably due to the ambiance and mid city location. There's a twist on some of the traditional dishes but I'll speak more on that later. It's totally worth it. As for the ambiance, it's on the trendy side. My favorite is the outdoor seating area, it's so romantic. It is partial outdoor seating, but there's still a ceiling and walls to protect from rain or cold weather. There are also large fire pits set up in this area and heat lamps to keep you warm if needed. Aside from the ambiance, I've alw...

My friend and I went here recently. It was my second visit, but just as good as the first. Gretchen was our server and she was fantastic; attentive, not overbearing, and really knowledgable about the food and drinks. We started with an order of the eggrolls, which are so good, and I got the rare filet pho and it was definitely on point. My only criticism was that my pho didn't come with bean sprouts, but instead cabbage. The serving was large and I was able to make two very filling dinners out of it. Prices are a little higher than a place like Lilly's, but for this being in my neighborhood, I'll take it. If you're in Mid-City and craving Vietnamese, this is your spot.

If you live anywhere near mid city, you know the options for good Vietnamese food are pretty dismal. I can't put into words how excited I was to see a Vietnamese cafe opening within walking distance to my house! The pho gods are smiling down on me! I was super excited to try Namese and it didn't disappoint! Namese is a cute and modernly stylish Vietnamese cafe that has recently opened on the corner of S. Carrollton and Tulane Ave. This area is pretty run down and trashy and is in serious need of new businesses, so this was a welcome addition to my hood.
